summary.result: The SATEEC was applied with hypothetical cropping scenario and it was found that the SATEEC can be used to assess the impacts of different management on the sediment delivered to the stream networks and to find the sediment source areas for a reach of interest.
summary.background: For an effective erosion control, it is necessary to compute sediment delivery ratio (SDR) for watershed and sediment yield at watershed outlet.
summary.method: The sediment yield using USDA SDR method is 8,544 ton/year and 4,949 ton/year with the method by Boyce.
